meta.name: arbor
meta.description: Autonomously improve a real artifact (code, training recipe, agent harness, data pipeline, prompt) against an objective and an evaluator, using Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR) from the Arbor paper. Use this whenever someone wants to iteratively optimize something over many experiments without overfitting — e.g. "get my model's eval score up", "improve this agent/harness", "tune this pipeline", "beat the baseline on this benchmark", "run a search over approaches and keep the best", "do an MLE-bench / Kaggle-style optimization", or any long-horizon "make this artifact better and don't just memorize the dev set" task. Trigger it even when the user doesn't say "Arbor" or "hypothesis tree" but describes repeated experiment-and-evaluate loops, branching exploration of competing ideas, or worries about a dev/test gap. Runs Claude itself as the coordinator with subagent executors in isolated git worktrees; for the standalone `arbor` CLI tool see references/arbor-upstream.md.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要反复实验迭代提升评估指标而不在测试集上过拟合
copy.tagline_en: Iteratively optimize artifacts like code, training recipes, and pipelines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to repeatedly experiment and improve artifacts without overfitting

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会自主地对一个工件（如代码、配置、提示词）进行多轮实验和评估，不断提出假设、执行测试、记录结果并提炼见解，最终选出改进最多的版本，同时避免过度拟合开发集。
howto.when: 当你请求迭代优化某个工件，需要多次实验和评估，并希望避免过拟合时触发。例如要求“提高模型评估分数”、“改进agent”或“调优管道”。

say.text: 帮我优化这个模型的F1分数，用验证集评估。
改进这个agent的通过率，用测试集验证结果。
say.note: Claude会提出多个改进方案并测试。

say.text: 调优这个数据管道，不要过拟合训练集。
say.note: Claude会管理假设树并合并最佳变更。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude autonomously runs multiple rounds of experiments and evaluation on an artifact (code, config, prompt). It proposes hypotheses, executes tests, records results, distills insights, and selects the best improvement while avoiding overfitting to the dev set.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request iterative optimization of an artifact with multiple experiments and evaluations, and want to avoid overfitting. Examples: "improve my model's eval score", "improve this agent", or "tune this pipeline".

say_en.text: Optimize this model's F1 score using the validation set.
Improve this agent's pass rate, verify with test set.
say_en.note: Claude proposes multiple improvements and tests them.

say_en.text: Tune this data pipeline, avoid overfitting to training data.
say_en.note: Claude manages hypothesis tree and merges best changes.
